limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 77 of 216 deposited raw files are not annotated. (a) 74 TMTpro files (YLJI_*_glyco_R1-R4_frac1-8, 32 files; YLJI_*_proteome_R1-R3_frac1-14, 42 files) are TMT, not SILAC, and out of scope for this SILAC campaign (their 16-channel map is in File_assignment.txt). (b) 3 SILAC files of experiment 505 were never searched: TO_S_Scheich_180221_220321_HFFR_505_WDH_L5_21.raw, _L5_22.raw, _L5_23.raw (not in MaxQuant_505 summary.txt; the search used undeposited files 180221_110321_HFFR_505_L5_6_WDH, 180221_100321_HFFR_505_L5_22, _L5_23 instead). Excluded rather than annotated with search parameters (lesson: unsearched runs excluded). Both recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md.
Experiment 505 is annotated with 20 of 23 gel slices (slices 1-5, 7-21; slice 6 was searched from an undeposited file and slices 22-23 only exist as unsearched re-acquisitions).

The deposited MaxQuant searches also contain experiments that are not deposited in PXD036363 (501-512 except 505; 1577-1581 except 1580; 1633-1638 except 1637; 2312; 537-546 except 539; pY R1/R2_2344, 2347, 2350, 2359). Only the deposited raw files are annotated.

pY profiling R1/R2: treated as two injections (technical replicates) of one enrichment per Sample ID because File_assignment gives a single Sample ID per experiment; it is not stated whether R1/R2 are separate enrichments.
Treatment of the BioID2 empty-vector and SPPLAT isotype-control channels is not stated in File_assignment.txt -> characteristics/factor value[treatment] and characteristics[compound] = not available.
SPPLAT (antibody-directed proximity labelling) is named only in File_assignment.txt; the paper text does not describe it, so the bait values restate File_assignment ("IgM 30 s", "Isotype control").
Treatment durations (24 h NGI-1/DMSO for BioID2 and SPPLAT; overnight for pY) are not encoded in a column.
MaxQuant version: deposited parameters.txt say 1.6.17.0 (1.6.5.0 for experiment 1580); paper/PRIDE say 1.6.5.0. Search FASTA Uniprot_human_210219_rev.fasta.

Instrument names in file names (Plus, HFFR, QEx, Fu) are not authoritative; the raw headers were used (1580/1637 "Plus" files report Q Exactive HF). Only the first file of each experiment/acquisition date was header-checked; collision energy assumed constant within an experiment (same method name).
